name: Mammon, the Golden
prompt:
A card picture for a 1990s-style fantasy trading card game, hand-made traditional media with visible texture, the matte, slightly faded look of a printed 1990s card. One clear subject that fills the frame, its focal point near the centre, readable at a glance even very small. Keep the bottom-left and bottom-right corners dark and simple. Landscape 3:2. No text, no letters, no inscriptions, no border, no frame, no logo, no watermark, no signature. Not photorealistic, not 3D render, not modern digital concept art, not anime, not a glossy oil painting.

Setting: the War in Heaven from the Bible (Genesis, 1 Enoch, Isaiah, Revelation): fallen angels, giants, demons and the beasts of the Apocalypse, shown as Christian sacred art showed them.

Look: a page from a medieval illuminated Apocalypse manuscript (Romanesque and Gothic Beatus and Apocalypse books, 10th-13th century). Bold, slightly naive black ink outlines; flat, unshaded areas of brilliant mineral colour: lapis-lazuli blue, vermilion, saffron yellow, verdigris green and rose madder; a burnished, tooled gold-leaf ground behind the figure, cracked and worn in places, on visible vellum. Stylised, flattened figures, decorative wavy bands of colour for sky and sea, stars drawn as little gold rosettes. Bright and decorative, like a page in a medieval Bible.

Subject: Mammon, the demon of riches: a bloated, crowned demon king seated on heaps of gold coins and treasure chests, clutching money bags, greedy eyes and a toothy grin.
